note: What a department may touch while it works, and where. Every rule is relative to that step's own workspace: a bare grant like `Read` reads the whole machine, including this repository, so scoping is the containment. Bash is granted to nobody -- it is scoped by command, never by path, so no workspace can bound it; work that needs to run something goes through a connector with its own admission control. Network and sub-agent tools are likewise ungranted until they are governed.
